module_issues: CONTRACT-REQUEST (town session via lead): house pieces have no anchors.board for door-board occupant tokens; indicators now pin tokens on the door leaf (scenes/ui-indicators.js) as a workaround.

Lead (scenes/ui-hud.js buildHudStage): m.head() = feet + spec.height + 0.1 is wrong for rigs whose spec.height is a prop top (storyteller H 1.91 = staff finial, hood about 1.55). Indicators work around it with VISUAL_TOP_M in hud.js; consider a spec field (e.g. headHeight) or per-id override in the stage so every group shares it.

Lead (src/ui/kit.js envelope): the dissolve is hard-wired to 200 ms (3 steps at 15 fps); the v2 bubble fadeOutMs 600 needed a local envelope in indicators/hud.js. Suggest an optional outMs/holdFrames argument.

Lead (crawl tooling): `ui=0` is only handled by the ui-hud scene path, not by scenes/ui-indicators.js, so the critic's 'UI adds 0 px' A/B comparison is not a real comparison for this scene. Also tools/crawl.py reports 924/860/884 diff px at its expected shift, while a hand alignment of the same frames gives 8/4/12, so the shift sign convention is worth checking.

Portraits group: icon_rabbit/ghost (and similar pale ghost busts) are nearly uniform pale blue at 12 px; indicators contrast-stretch them and fall back to an initial, but the icons themselves could carry more value contrast.

scenes/char-stage.js createActor: for non-idle loop clips it calls ch.play(clip) without `at`, and Character.play stamps that with engine.time. Any actor whose clock is offset (batched bakes, frozen stage clocks) never shows the clip. I work around it by replaying with play(clip, {at: 0}). Suggested fix: pass at: st.clock(engine.time) or 0.

scenes/char-stage.js createActor with pin: true plus a LegGait plan (frog, mushroom, fox, owl, crow, goat, toad, honk, partly rabbit): the gait does not step on a pinned treadmill root, and specs without an authored clips.walk fall back to idle. This likely affects tools/bake.py sprite walk rows too (out/sprites/*). I walk them for real instead (move: true) and crop around the root's ground point.

scenes/ui-hud.js m.head(): the head anchor (pos + spec.height + 0.1) sits about 10 or more texels above the visible head for several members (e.g. rabbit/Esme, see shots/ui-portraits/r1/world-noon.png), likely because spec.height includes ears/staff or falls back to 1.3. It needs a per-member visible-top value for anchored UI (labels, icons).

src/ui/social-bake.js meta merge: my bake meta also carries avatar_* anchors, a full headCrops (new-style semantics: head box in the 32x40 cell + face + iconPpm) and newStyle. The composite copies all of them into social.json meta. Consider filtering anchors to frames actually present, or tell me to split meta by atlas.

src/ui/placeholders.js: the portraits slot only covers the 24x24 dock button. The notebook icons are drawn at the lead's placeholder row positions inside the panels slot (pr.x+7, row y+6). If the panels group lays out its rows differently, CONTRACT-REQUEST: export the row avatar rects (or a hud.avatarSlots list) so portraits can follow them.

Known weak spots in this group: icon_rabbit (only the pink ear tips read) and the pale ghost-spent/dead icons of the round-headed members are featureless at 12 px. The 3D faces carry no feature that survives 12 px. Fixing it would need a portrait-specific face part per character (cast pipeline) or hand-drawn icon overrides.

issues.problem: In-world pops anchor to m.head() (spec.height) minus a fixed 11 px label offset and ignore the indicators helpers. The Storyteller's height is the staff finial, so its pop floats about 20 texels above the hood, right under Ada's feet, and is attributed to the wrong character (r1/z-pop-day.png; r2/others-day.png at about 640,195; r2/z-pops.png). The pin tooltip floats about 60 texels above Bram in grass when no person pin is drawn (r2/tooltip.png at 890,75).
issues.fix: Place pops and the tooltip with hud.indicators.labelTop(m, L) / stackTop(m, L) when present (it already handles VISUAL_TOP_M and ghost lift). Otherwise fall back to a per-id visual top like indicators' VISUAL_TOP_M. Anchor the tooltip to the actual pin top from markers, not a fixed +29.

issues.problem: There is no shared stack top, so at night Finn's '?' pop draws over his two person pins, covering both pin discs (r2/z-finn-night.png, screen about 325,255). Pops, person pins and bubbles all claim 'above the label'.
issues.fix: CONTRACT-REQUEST to the lead: one shared stack allocator (labels < bubble < pins < pop) on the hud. Emotes then draws pops at its returned top.

issues.problem: The pin pop is always gold: anim commits 'Pin Bram · teal', then the pop over the pinner shows a gold pin (anim/s-commit.png vs anim/s-pop-in.png). The pop can't say which pin was dropped.
issues.fix: Bake emote_pop_pin_<color>_<f> (or tint the glyph with PIN_RAMPS[c]) and pass the committed colour to the pop.

issues.problem: Pie open frame 0 (emote_pie_*_open_0) and commit frames 4-5 draw a flat, featureless near-black disc 72-92 texels wide with only a hub dot or ring. At 1x it blinks as a hole over the world (anim/s-open.png frames 2-3, anim/s-commit.png frames 4-5).
issues.fix: Open_0: a smaller ring outline + hub (or the back ring with wedge separators at radius r0..R-6). Commit: keep the wedge separators/rim on the back disc while the other icons dissolve, or dissolve the back with the others.

issues.problem: Armed pill layout: the 'Cancel' button text touches its right frame, and the pin icon overlaps the pill's left gold keyline. The text wraps to 2 lines in a cramped box (r2/z-armed.png; screen about 1035-1200, 600-640).
issues.fix: Size the pill from textWidth + icon + button + insets (one line: 'Click to drop your pin'), and keep the icon inside the content rect (inset 2 + padding).

issues.problem: The tiny font's M reads as N/H: the touch pie Remove wedge label reads 'RENOVE' (r2/z-remove-touch.png). Same bug as the documented RMB→RHB.
issues.fix: A 5-wide M in FONTS.tiny (kit, lead). Until then, use the body font for wedge labels.

issues.problem: The black pin swatch/wedge/mini pin is drawn hollow (outline + centre dot only). Next to the disabled wedges' grey silhouettes it reads as empty/disabled, not as a black pin. v2 draws a solid dark pin with a light rim (refs/ui/emotes/v2-emotes.png).
issues.fix: Solid PIN_RAMPS.black fill with a cream/iron rim on the upper left so it reads on ink panels.

issues.problem: The pie notch ('current pin colour' per meta) is drawn goldHi/gold whatever the colour: next to the crimson wedge it is a 2x2 gold speck that reads as noise (r1/z-pie-day.png, right of the crimson wedge).
issues.fix: Draw the notch in PIN_RAMPS[color].hi/mid as documented, or drop it, since the hot wedge and dock swatch already show the colour.

issues.problem: Pop glyphs at 7-9 px are hard to read: the Point pop glove reads as a mitten blob, and the pin pop reads as a lightbulb/key (r2/z-pops.png, bake/z-icons.png).
issues.fix: Use the 9x9 straight-finger glove (emote_point_9) and the 9x12 pin with its cream disc inside a slightly taller pop. Or make the pop a rounded speech bubble (bubble tokens) for clearer 'emote' semantics.

issues.problem: Dock key hints say 'LEFT unpin'. v2 says 'click your pin to remove'. The baked emote_kbd frame still says 'RMB' (reads 'RHB') while the scene uses RIGHT.
issues.fix: Copy: 'RIGHT point · DRAG menu · F pin · click your pin: remove'. Bake the same chips the scene uses.

issues.problem: Disabled state (6/6 pins): the dock still shows Pin + swatches as fully active, and the 'clear' hover isn't visibly different from normal (r2/z-disabled.png).
issues.fix: Show the cap in the dock: dim the swatches or add a '6/6' badge on Pin, and use a hover frame (FRAMES hover) on Clear my pins.

issues.problem: emote_point_9 is baked 9x8, but bake.js and the meta say 9x9 (inline glyph grid in UI.md 2.6).
issues.fix: Pad to 9x9 (baseline-aligned) or fix the meta/comment.

c1.verdict: Not ready to ship. The art itself passes the bar (22/24 on ART_DIRECTION with no zeros on 1-4, 29/36 counting the six UI criteria). The pie and dock read clearly and match v2, with clean ramps and lines, a clean palette, correct 30 Hz stepping and 0 UI crawl. What blocks it is the in-world pop, one of the group's four parts. It anchors to spec.height, so the Storyteller's pop is attributed to the wrong character. With no shared stack, a pop also covers Finn's person pins at night. Fix those, plus the gold-only pin pop, the black void disc on the pie's open and commit frames, and the armed pill layout, then re-review.
